name: svg-french-press-qwen3.8-27b-v2-s2-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 940" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="14" height="14" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="14" height="14" fill="#e3ecef"/>
      <path d="M0 0 H14 M0 0 V14" stroke="#8d99a6" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <rect width="640" height="940" fill="#fbfbf7"/>
  <text x="320" y="32" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#222">French press — exploded assembly view</text>

  <!-- dashed centerline -->
  <line x1="240" y1="48" x2="240" y2="868" stroke="#b6b6b6" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 6"/>

  <!-- ===== Plunger handle (top knob) ===== -->
  <rect x="160" y="52" width="160" height="26" rx="13" fill="#8a5a3b" stroke="#5d3d26" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="172" y1="65" x2="220" y2="65" stroke="#a9764f" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- ===== Plunger rod ===== -->
  <rect x="236" y="78" width="8" height="148" fill="#9aa4ad" stroke="#5b646d" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- ===== Spring (coil) ===== -->
  <g stroke="#7c8790" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="252" rx="55" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="264" rx="55" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="276" rx="55" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="288" rx="55" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="300" rx="55" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="312" rx="55" ry="7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== Filter disc (wire mesh) ===== -->
  <ellipse cx="240" cy="372" rx="130" ry="20" fill="url(#mesh)" stroke="#55606a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="240" cy="372" rx="130" ry="20" fill="none" stroke="#313a42" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.35"/>
  <circle cx="240" cy="372" r="5" fill="#55606a"/>

  <!-- ===== Lid ===== -->
  <rect x="105" y="415" width="270" height="42" rx="12" fill="#2f3640" stroke="#14181d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="240" cy="436" r="9" fill="#14181d" stroke="#55606a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="118" y="422" width="120" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#4b5563" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- ===== Glass beaker with spout ===== -->
  <path d="M 106 522 L 130 500 L 130 545 Z" fill="#cfe6f2" stroke="#5b7f95" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M 130 500 L 350 500 L 336 793 Q 335 805 323 805 L 157 805 Q 145 805 144 793 Z"
        fill="#cfe6f2" fill-opacity="0.75" stroke="#5b7f95" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M 152 520 Q 148 650 156 780" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" fill="none" opacity="0.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- ===== Base ===== -->
  <rect x="130" y="835" width="220" height="22" rx="8" fill="#2f3640" stroke="#14181d" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- ===== Leader lines + labels ===== -->
  <g stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="324" y1="65"  x2="398" y2="65"/>
    <line x1="246" y1="150" x2="398" y2="150"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="282" x2="398" y2="282"/>
    <line x1="372" y1="372" x2="398" y2="372"/>
    <line x1="377" y1="436" x2="398" y2="436"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="650" x2="398" y2="650"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="846" x2="398" y2="846"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="17" fill="#333">
    <text x="404" y="70">Plunger handle</text>
    <text x="404" y="155">Plunger rod</text>
    <text x="404" y="287">Spring</text>
    <text x="404" y="377">Filter disc</text>
    <text x="404" y="441">Lid</text>
    <text x="404" y="655">Glass beaker</text>
    <text x="404" y="851">Base</text>
  </g>

  <!-- spout callout -->
  <line x1="110" y1="527" x2="88" y2="558" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="84" y="572" font-size="14" fill="#333" text-anchor="end">Pour spout</text>

  <!-- note -->
  <text x="320" y="915" font-size="15" fill="#777" text-anchor="middle">Plunger filter: three pieces — rod, spring, and wire-mesh disc</text>
</svg>
